constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES auth.users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
constraints.name: accounts_user_id_fkey

constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (account_id) REFERENCES accounts(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
constraints.name: budget_categories_account_id_fkey

constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (account_id) REFERENCES accounts(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
constraints.name: holdings_account_id_fkey

constraints.definition: CHECK (((symbol IS NOT NULL) OR (name IS NOT NULL)))
constraints.name: holdings_check

constraints.definition: CHECK ((((valuation_basis = 'manual-value'::text) AND (manual_value_cents IS NOT NULL) AND (shares IS NULL) AND (manual_price_cents IS NULL)) OR ((valuation_basis = 'shares-and-price'::text) AND (shares IS NOT NULL) AND (manual_value_cents IS NULL))))
constraints.name: holdings_check1

constraints.definition: CHECK ((((dividend_policy <> 'custom'::text) AND (capital_gains_policy <> 'custom'::text)) OR (custom_policy_note IS NOT NULL)))
constraints.name: holdings_check2

constraints.definition: CHECK (((contribution_cents IS NULL) OR (contribution_frequency IS NOT NULL)))
constraints.name: holdings_contribution_requires_frequency

constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (account_id) REFERENCES accounts(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
constraints.name: home_properties_account_id_fkey

constraints.definition: CHECK (((county_fips IS NULL) OR ((county_fips ~ '^[0-9]{5}$'::text) AND (state_code IS NOT NULL))))
constraints.name: home_properties_county_valid

constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (account_id) REFERENCES accounts(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
constraints.name: income_sources_account_id_fkey

constraints.definition: CHECK (((date_of_birth IS NOT NULL) OR (current_age IS NOT NULL) OR ((stop_investing_age IS NULL) AND (retirement_age IS NULL))))
constraints.name: plan_scenario_age_required

constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (account_id) REFERENCES accounts(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
constraints.name: plan_settings_account_id_fkey

constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (account_id) REFERENCES accounts(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
constraints.name: portfolio_snapshots_account_id_fkey

constraints.definition: CHECK (((property_equity_cents IS NULL) OR (((total_value_cents + property_equity_cents) >= '-9007199254740991'::bigint) AND ((total_value_cents + property_equity_cents) <= '9007199254740991'::bigint))))
constraints.name: portfolio_snapshots_net_worth_safe_check
